subject: QBR prep: executive brief, priority re-scope, and dependency asks
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyanka Sharma <psharma@acmedata.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: executive brief, priority re-scope, and dependency asks

Team —

Putting a short readout together for next Wednesday’s QBR. Two high-level asks up front: (1) agree the one-page exec brief (attached, v0.9) and (2) confirm the minimal re-scope we discussed so we can push the remaining work into the follow-on sprint.

Snapshot (high level):
- OKR: Improve API p99 latency by 10% vs baseline — currently tracking ~6% improvement; steady, but risk on long-tail (seq>1024).
- OKR: Dedicated customers — on-track for commits, but Acme needs an isolated demo env + SOC quick answers to close deal.
- OKR: Private deployment pilot — blocked by infra gating (network policy + KMS config).

Proposed re-scope for QBR narrative (keeps deliverable integrity, reduces cross-team risk):
1) Defer non-blocking telemetry UI polish (slice B) to after QBR.
2) Prioritize kernel-level fallback for long-sequence requests (slice A) — requires two infra PRs (see dependency matrix).
3) Keep Dedicated on full path to GA but surface demo to Acme with scoped data retention notes.

Dependency asks / action owners:
- Infra: approve PRs #4132 and #4178 for KV-cache eviction changes. ETA: 72 hours (Vanessa please confirm).
- Security: SOC answers for Acme (Priyanka) — assemble answers to the shared questionnaire; Naomi, can you own coordination?
- Sales/SE: staged demo environment with reduced retention (demo seed) by Mon 10/19 — Markus, can you reprioritize SE cycles?

Attachments: QBR_brief_v0.9.pdf (exec onepager), dependency_matrix.xlsx (detailed callouts). Link to draft here: https://drive.google.com/link/to/QBR_brief_v0.9

Asks for this thread: please reply with ownership confirmations and any changes to the re-scope language by EOD so I can lock the deck and circulate to execs tomorrow morning.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Product, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com


From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: executive brief, priority re-scope, and dependency asks

Kimberly —

Ack and thanks for the clear asks. Quick updates:
- I’ll take ownership of the infra PR approvals. I’ll prioritize a review this morning and flag anything blocker-y. ETA: latest EOD today; target to merge 10/19 if clean.
- For the long-sequence fallback, I propose we gate the rollout behind a canary on dedicated infra first — will include the rollout plan in the PR description.

On the demo env for Acme: I can allocate the necessary infra slot but need confirmation of the reduced retention window (30 days?) and the KMS approach. Priyanka — can you confirm minimal acceptable retention and whether a scoped demo key is sufficient?

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Infrastructure
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2026 12:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: executive brief, priority re-scope, and dependency asks

Kimberly / team —

I’ll own the SOC coordination for Acme. Immediate plan:
- I’ll pull the completed questionnaire answers out of our security binder and flag the two items Acme highlighted (data-retention and key segregation).
- I’ll schedule a 30-minute sync with Priyanka and Will Turner (Acme infra lead) tomorrow 10/18 at 11:00 to close the remaining gating Qs. Priyanka — is that time okay?
- I attached an updated dependency matrix (dependency_matrix.xlsx) with clear owners and the minimal acceptance criteria for each gate. Please review column G (acceptance) and comment.

Metrics note for the QBR deck: can we include the last 7-day p99 slice for seq>1024 and a table of cost impact for the proposed fallback? I can pull the p99 from our monitoring dashboard if someone shares the internal read-only link.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Trust & Safety Operations
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

Subject: Re: QBR prep: executive brief, priority re-scope, and dependency asks

Thanks — quick decision and a couple of concrete commitments from my side: 
- I support the proposed re-scope (defer telemetry polish; prioritize fallback kernel). That gives us a cleaner narrative for execs and reduces cross-team risk.
- I will reallocate one SE (Jordan) from the internal demo backlog to own the Acme staging demo and coordinate with Vanessa for infra provisioning. Markus note: Jordan will be available Monday and can pair with Vanessa to validate retention/KMS configuration.
- Kimberly: please update slide 2 to explicitly call out the risk statement for long-sequence p99 and the mitigation timeline (PR approvals -> canary -> GA). I can sign the finalized deck after that small edit.

Markus Klein
VP, Customer Solutions
markus_klein@redwood.com
